reason: Crashing a page, which Strider can't cause on Firefox or stock WebKit: the public API has no crash, and the only trigger the port has is Chromium's chrome://crash navigation. The matrix row event-page-crash says Strider has the crash, but it observes a crash through the page's closed reason; it doesn't cause one

Port: A Page.crash sent over a second CDP connection to the page's target doesn't end the page within the test's 30 seconds on Chromium 155: page.closed never resolves, and the page's release then waits another 30 seconds on restoreViewport, so each test times out
